hooks.text: Tired of your AI constantly producing the same generic AI slop as everybody else?  Here are four free plugins that fix it.  First, use Impeccable for design, which gives Claude real design taste pulled from premium references, so your guys' UI stops looking vibe-coded.

Someone just built the world's biggest prompt library, and made it completely free and open-source.  It's called prompts. chat, and it has over 10,000 prompts for writing, coding, images, video, and research, plus readymade skills and workflows for pretty much any task you guys can think of.

If you want to get better front-end designs, then instead of prompting from scratch, you can just use the design language of all the top brands like Tesla, Apple, Ferrari, and even Anthropic, and put them directly in your work.  Somebody just reverse engineered over 2,000 websites from the world's top brands, and put them all in design files that your Claude code can read and use directly.  And every file contains their entire visual system: the exact colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts that they use, plus clear rules on what to do and what not to do.

This free AI tool lets you clone any website with just a single screenshot.  It's called Screenshot to Code and it's a fully open source project with over 72,000 stars on GitHub.  You just drop in a screenshot and it'll read the layout, the spacing, the fonts, the colors, and even build the entire website for you live.

New free learning platform to help you master Claude completely free.  Inside, you'll get access to full courses on Claude Code, Claude projects, the Claude API, and also how to use it to build anything you want.  So if you're a total beginner, this is the best place to start.

Don't start vibe coding with Claude Code unless you've installed these four plugins.  The first is Ponytail, which optimizes Claude Code's output and cuts your token usage by over 50% without losing you any accuracy at all.  The second is Omniroute, which gives Claude Code almost unlimited usage by connecting it to over 300 other free AI providers.

This free AI tool lets you scrape anything off the internet without paying for anything.  It's called ScrapeGraphAI, and it's an open-source Python library with over 30,000 stars on GitHub.  You just give it a website link and describe what you want in plain English, and then a minute later, it'll come back with a clean list of everything that you asked for.

If you use Claude Code with multiple skills and plugins installed, your PC might have gotten hacked.  A recent study found that 26% of AI skills contain security vulnerabilities, and a whopping 5% actually already have malicious code stuffed inside it.  So to fix this, NVIDIA built a free tool called SkillSpector, which basically acts like an antivirus sitting between your Claude Code and the agent skills you're about to install.

Google just dropped over 100 AI skills that make your Claude code an expert on Google's entire stack.  It's called Google's Agent Skills, and it's a free open-source library that's already crossed 18,000 stars on GitHub.  So instead of guessing, your coding agent now follows Google's own official playbooks for handling Google Analytics, Google Gemini, Ads, Cloud, and even Firebase.

If you're using Claude Code, you need to install these five AI plugins and skills right now.  The first is Claude Code Setup.  It's an official plugin from Anthropic that scans your entire codebase and recommends the best hooks, skills, and sub-agents that fit your project, as well as removes all of the unnecessary stuff.

These three Claude plugins let you scrape anything off the internet without paying for anything.  The first is ScrapeGraphAI that lets you scrape any website with a simple text prompt.  You just tell it what you want, and it'll come back with clean structured data instantly.

This free AI tool lets you connect your Claude Code to any app or any tool that you use, even ones that don't have an official MCP or connector, and it's completely free.  It's called CLI-Anything, and it lets your Claude Code build a CLI, or command-line interface, for basically any software that you use, including the local tools that are sitting on your computer right now.  All you do is point it at an app or a repo, and then it'll read the code, write its own commands, and even install everything for you completely automatically.

You can now create Apple level websites with Claude using this one skill.  So somebody on GitHub just compressed years of Apple's design thinking into a single skill with the exact colors, fonts, motion, and rules that they use across every product.  With it, you guys can create premium animated websites like this or use it to fix and upgrade your existing projects.

DeepSeek just launched a free version of Claude Code, and it's already crossed 180,000 stars on GitHub in under a week.  It's called DeepSeek Harness, and unlike Claude Code, it's fully customizable.  It's basically built on the idea that everything inside it is a plugin, including the model, the tools, the memory, and even the agent loop itself.
You don't have to pay for Runway or Kling AI videos anymore.  LTX 2. 5 just dropped, and it's a completely open video model.

If you guys want to get better front-end designs with Claude Code, here are five plugins you need to install right now.  The first is Taste Skill that pulls real design taste from premium references so your UI stops looking crappy and vibe coded.  The second is the Vercel Web Design Guidelines skill.

Create on-brand UI designs with no design experience required.  First, head over to Replit Design and just describe what you're building in plain English.  Their design agent will take it from there, laying out your page and suggesting what to do next at every step.
Stop pretending you know how to use Claude.  Give me 60 seconds and I can guarantee you, you'll know more than 99. 9% of people in AI.

If you have a super long Claude chat, number one, you're hitting your usage limits frequently.  And number two, you cannot continue chatting in the same chat anymore.  So go to your chat and prompt, create a markdown file for this chat.

These are my AI employees and as a team they run my business.  They can make video ads, do sales, branding, and even end-to-end marketing.  So let me show you how you can create AI employees for your business or a client completely free.

The new Porsche Taycan color which I just bought last month.  Now look at this, what this new ChatGPT model Astra 6 did to it.  I just gave it couple of images of my car, it searched the whole internet, went to Blender, and created this amazing super super detailed 3D render.
Hello.  All right, let me show you how to make it.  Take a photo of yourself and the products you want to show in the video.
Silence is never empty.  It's scary when you are alone.  Something followed me there.

Tired of trading time for money?  Then I'm going to show you what services to sell, who to sell, and how to sell to make passive income.  And all you need is your laptop.
